title: Bind products to releases and distributions
objective: Correct independently reproduced release identity, source binding and generation consistency defects and current package seal. Original logical base 15b351a92af729f9ba07359fd210123fdfd76bb3 and original branch/task grok-pr007-release-binding remain the PR provenance; continuation execution base is 994779418cdf4ac2bcc023da66eb1b05aae696d6 on this managed branch.
outcome: Source-native identities can supply actual context IDs to clients.

commits.subject: Define release and distribution identity rules
commits.instructions: Reuse the existing source/release/distribution contracts; add publisher identifiers, locator, release/revision date roles and hash-scoped identity when a publisher supplies no stable release ID.
commits.verification: Fixtures cover rolling endpoints, a replacement file, multiple distributions and conflicting dates without merging them.

commits.subject: Resolve exact source relationships
commits.instructions: Implement deterministic binding from captured catalog/resources records to releases and distributions. Preserve ambiguous and unresolved alternatives with evidence pointers.
commits.verification: One-to-many publisher distributions remain distinct; an ambiguous URL never produces a fabricated exact binding.

commits.subject: Add generation identity mapping
commits.instructions: Publish one explicit map between human manifest identity, machine generation and dictionary/source revision. Reject inconsistent cross-generation references.
commits.verification: Human-to-machine source lookup returns the same product context; stale or mismatched pins yield typed restart guidance.

commits.subject: Correct release identity, source binding, and generation map
commits.instructions: Correct independently reproduced identity, binding and generation defects. Refresh the current identity package seal from actual bytes. Preserve frozen contract pins and original three planned commits.
commits.verification: Independent semantics cases pass; npm run validate --prefix packages/identity matches current package bytes.
